00028.name: Master Black
00028.help: Raises or lowers the black level of the whole picture.
00028.evidence: FS7M2 rounds 17-23 (2026-10-13), clicked one wheel click at a time: every stored value is a whole multiple of 41.351 (one wheel click; 8 clicks = 330.8, about one menu step). The camera shows the click count divided by 8, cut towards zero: 0 for -7..+7 clicks (-289..+289), -1 from -8 (-331) to -15 (-620), -2 from -16 (-662), -3 from -24 (-992), -4 up to -39 (-1613), -5 from -40 (-1654 .. -1778 at -43); +1 starts at +8 (+331). Measured: -827 (-20), -662 (-16), -620 (-15), -331 (-8), -289 (-7), +289 (+7), +331 (+8), -992, -1613, -1778. The Mk1 values (-1075, -1158, -1654) are multiples of the same unit (26, 28, 40 clicks) but do not fit the 8-click menu raster of the Mk2: the Mk1 menu step width is not measured. The range of 99 menu steps = 792 clicks is an assumption (32767 / 41.351 = 792.4).

00126.name: White Clip Level (90.0 to 109.0 %, file value x 10)
00126.help: Upper limit of the video signal, 90 to 109 %. 109 % practically turns the clip off. Not available with S-Log2 or S-Log3.

The RAW output format itself is not in 00150 (constant 4096x2160 59.94p in 016/017, the user's setting). | 018.ALL (RAW & XAVC-L) = codec index 8, internal 1920x1080 59.94p with XAVC-L fields 7=4, 9=11, 11=5, 12=1, 13=1, 14=0; 019.ALL (RAW & MPEG HD422) = codec index 9, internal 1280x720 59.94p with the MPEG fields 7=8, 9=3, 11=0, 12=0, 13=1, 14=0. widget.note: Choose the codec first, then the format (resolution/frame rate); the list shows only the formats known for the codec. When the codec changes, a format with the same resolution and frame rate is chosen, otherwise the first one in the list. With RAW the RAW is stored externally only; the resolution here is the internally recorded format. Choosing a format also sets the values that move with it (e.g. Imager Scan Mode) from the sample files. Not every combination is possible on the camera; only formats known from files are offered. The RAW output is a position in the list of the camera menu (NTSC); with PAL (50p/25p) the same number means the PAL counterpart. Formats marked '– assumption' come from the menu lists of the manuals (NTSC and PAL; the 35/25 Mbps bit-rate variants are missing); only resolution, frame rate and scan are set, the format index (field 14) and the companion values (00175 etc.) are not checked.

00192.name: White Memory <A> (R Gain, B Gain; Color Temp)
00192.help: White balance stored in memory A: R gain, B gain and the resulting colour temperature. The camera sets it when you run an auto white balance.
00192.evidence: FS7M2 round 133 (2026-10-20, ALL + SCENE, WHT BAL switch on A): R Gain <A> 0 -> +15, B Gain <A> 0 -> -26, Color Temp Balance <A> 0 -> -5 and Color Temp <A> 3200 -> 4042 K (the menu values depend on each other) changed 00192 from 0,0,3200 to 5117,-8584,4042; scene 00164 and the pair 00144 the same. The colour temperature (third value) is worked out by the camera from the gains (fits the older files within a few percent: 591,2394,3112 / 6198,-20281,4985), it is not edited here.

widget.note: R Gain and B Gain are stored finer than the menu step; the camera shows the step cut towards zero (5117 = +15, -8584 = -26). Color Temp Balance, which the camera shows, is the mean of both gains. The third value of the row, the colour temperature in K, is worked out by the camera from the gains and is not changed here. The items of the memory can be edited with the WHT BAL switch on A (memory A) or B (memory B).

Round 54 (2026-10-14, 25P format): Mode ECS -> Speed, Shutter Speed 1/50 -> 1/25 and ECS Frequency 49.77 -> 55.02 Hz changed fields 0 (2 -> 0), 2 (4 -> 3), 3 (559 -> 613) and 6 (7 -> 6) and nothing else. Round 56 (2026-10-14, ALL only, 25P): ECS Frequency 34.00 Hz (after switching Mode Speed -> ECS: field 0 0 -> 2) gives field 3 = 297.
